item.title: Woman fatally struck by vehicle on Coliseum Boulevard in Fort Wayne
item.description: Woman fatally hit by vehicle while crossing Coliseum Boulevard in Fort Wayne. Driver stopped and cooperated with police investigation.

item.title: Indiana AG sues Lake Castleton Apartments for neglecting tenant safety
item.description: Indiana Attorney General files lawsuit against Lake Castleton Apartments for neglecting repairs, endangering tenants, and violating state law.

item.title: Delaware County remembers corporal killed while aiding stranded driver on I-69
item.description: Remembering Cpl. Blake Reynolds, a dedicated and beloved sheriff's corporal, who died while assisting a disabled semi.

item.title: Investigators give update in 3-vehicle crash that killed Indiana National Guard specialist
item.description: Fatal crash on I-65 involving military Humvee and civilian vehicles claims life of Indiana National Guardsman. Investigation ongoing.

item.title: Indiana legislature bucks governor, adjourns until Jan. 5
item.description: State lawmakers in Indiana adjourn until January, likely killing the chance of a redistricting session. Governor threatens to compel Senate to meet.

item.title: Decertification case for Dubois County sheriff advances with April 2026 hearing plan
item.description: (INDIANA CAPITAL CHRONICLE) — A state law enforcement board on Monday took its next step toward deciding whether Dubois County Sheriff Tom Kleinhelter should lose his police certification. After a brief procedural meeting at the Indiana Law Enforcement Academy in Plainfield the pending case against Kleinhelter is tentatively on track for lengthy evidentiary hearings in April. […]

item.title: Carmel man's charge of plotting to murder wife dismissed due to venue issue
item.description: Charges dropped against Carmel man accused of plotting to murder wife. Case dismissed due to improper venue. Could be refiled in Marion County.

item.title: Cool and cloudy today, rain to hit central Indiana by Thursday night | Nov. 19, 2025
item.description: Central Indiana faces cool and damp weather with fog, followed by a significant rain event. Expect around 1 inch of rainfall from Thursday to Saturday.

item.title: Clinton County shooting on State Road 29 wounds 3, including town marshal
item.description: Police officer and suspect injured in shooting on State Road 29 in Clinton County, Indiana.

item.title: Man killed, other seriously hurt in crash at 25th Street, Sherman Drive
item.description: A fatal crash in Indianapolis leaves one man dead and another hospitalized after striking a utility pole. Sherman Drive and 25th Street are closed.
